properties.description:
Two probes. THE CASE: an event written with no `detected_at` carries an `undated` note that names the field AND what cannot be computed without it — the assertion deliberately requires the note to say what the absence COSTS, because a bare "no date" is the silent behaviour with extra words. It also checks the event was still written, so the note cannot drift into a refusal. SILENT: a dated event has nothing to report.

OBSERVED FAILING FIRST against the unfixed binary, 2026-09-10: "no `undated` block in: {changed:[], event:{...}}". The silent probe passed vacuously, as it must when nothing fires at all.

⚠️ SCOPE, so a green reading is not over-read: this covers `add_change_event`, which is the tool that HAS the field and the one hxm_program was using. `record_change` — the path the root-cause discipline sends you to — carries `repair` but no date at all and is untouched here. See `fact:record-change-places-an-event-by-epoch-and-212-of-214-epochs-carry-no-date`.
properties.name: an_undated_change_event_says_so.rs — the note, and the silence when it is dated
